content:
Day 5 of the Amazon Black Friday sale is on fire with an insane $100 off AirPods Pro 3 and over $300 off M5 MacBook Air, but the Apple Watch deals just got a whole lot better too.

You’ll now find Apple Watch Series 12 down even lower, with new all-time lows at $100 off and deals starting from $299. The new Ultra 4 is now back at all-time lows with nearly $100 in savings, and the latest Apple Watch SE 3 models are now starting at just $179 shipped.

Apple Watch Series 12

Apple Watch Series 12 landed with an all-new Dark Bronze colorway, all-new health features, as much as double the RAM, and a new Ceramic finish running on the S11 chip in September. It then landed at $70 off to kick off Black Friday month, and now just about every model has dropped even lower at $100 off across the board:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 $299 (Reg. $399) – All-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 $349 (Reg. $449) – All-time low
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 Cell $399 (Reg. $499) – All-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 Cell $449 (Reg. $549) – All-time low

Apple Watch Series 12 Ceramic

We are also getting all-time low pricing on the high-end Ceramic models, and now the 42mm Night Blue variant has dropped again with a notable $100 price drop:

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Pearl White $829 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Night Blue $799 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic Night Blue $879 (Reg. $949) – All-time low

Apple Watch Ultra 4

Alongside a collection of all-new bands, Apple Watch Ultra 4 debuted alongside the Series 12 as Apple’s latest and greatest high-end model starting at $799. It is, however, Black Friday, and while not every config is marked down, several of them have now dropped back down to the lowest prices to date at nearly $100 off:

  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Translucent Gray Ocean $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Sand Trail $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 Desert Alpine $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 4 Burgundy Trail $699 (Reg. $799)

Apple Watch SE 3

Apple’s latest SE series wearable is not to be overlooked if you ask me. The most compelling SE release to date, complete with the must-have always-on display and gesture support, not everyone on your list needs all the bells and whistles on the Series and Ultra models, and you can pick one of the 2026 configurations up for just $179 shipped right now in the Amazon Black Friday sale:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Midnight $179 (Reg. $249) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Starlight $179 (Reg. $249) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Midnight $209 (Reg. $279) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Starlight $209 (Reg. $279) – All-time low

And remember, the only way to properly clean your Apple Watch display is with the next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth and it is now back in stock at $9 Prime shipped on Amazon – the world’s great stocking stuffer for Apple users (not compatible with Android devices).

More of the best Black Friday Week Apple deals:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – Now even lower
  • AirPods Max 2 $419 (Reg. $549) – $130 off
  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • MacBook Neo 256GB $650 (Reg. $700)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB $750 (Reg. $800)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $989 (Reg. $1,299) – $310 off!
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,799 (Reg. $1,999) – All-time low
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (Reg. $2,199) – All-time low
  • NEW OLED iPad mini (A20 Pro) $599 (Reg. $699) – All-time low
  • Apple Pencil (USB-C) $49 (Reg. $79)
